items.definition:
smoked salmon, typically thinly sliced
I ordered a bagel with cream cheese and lox for breakfast.

a dog of no definable type or breed
Our family dog is a lovable mongrel with a mix of breeds.

a person of high social standing or wealth (informal, often derogatory)
He acts like a real nob, always looking down on others.

a person who objects to something
There was only one objector to the new proposal.

perpetrator (informal)
The police are still searching for the perp.

a strong feeling that something is about to happen, especially something unpleasant
She had a premonition that something bad was going to happen.

a person who is obsessed with fire; a pyromaniac
The police suspected a pyro was responsible for the recent fires.

the act of considering something again, especially for a possible change of decision
The committee agreed to a reconsideration of the proposal.

a muscle or part that rotates
The shoulder's rotator cuff is crucial for arm movement.

a person or system that schedules
The operating system's scheduler manages CPU time for different processes.

A very small amount of money; a shoelace.
They started the business on a shoestring budget.

A person who looks after livestock.
The stockman spent his days tending to the cattle.

A person who performs dangerous stunts, especially in films.
The stuntman performed a dangerous jump from the moving car.

A prong or point, such as on a fork or antler.
Be careful not to bend the tines of the fork.

shiny decorative strips
The Christmas tree was decorated with bright tinsel.

an amount of power expressed in watts
Check the wattage of the light bulb before installing it.

a plant with stiff, sword-shaped leaves
A large yucca plant grew in the desert garden.

light or radiance remaining after the source has disappeared; a pleasant feeling remaining after a positive experience
The afterglow of the sunset painted the sky in vibrant colors.

a single-celled organism that can change its shape
Under the microscope, we observed the amoeba moving slowly.

idiot; fool (Japanese loanword)
Don't be such a baka, you can do it!

a small, flat, reddish-brown insect that feeds on the blood of humans and other animals
They discovered bedbugs in their hotel room.

a large volcanic crater, typically formed by the collapse of the mouth of a volcano
The lake formed within the ancient caldera of the volcano.

the most important or attractive item in a collection or display
The large sculpture was the centrepiece of the exhibition.

a type of long reclining chair, often part of a 'chaise longue'
She relaxed on the chaise longue by the pool.

a type of cabbage with loose leaves, typically eaten as a vegetable
She cooked a delicious dish with collard greens.

the study and practice of cosmetics and the treatment of the skin, hair, and nails
She decided to pursue a career in cosmetology.

a steep, rugged rock or cliff
The climber scaled the jagged crag with difficulty.

the skull, especially the part enclosing the brain
The human cranium protects the brain.

a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal
The noise level exceeded 90 decibels.

an excellent or remarkable thing
That goal was a real dilly!

an area of docks and associated warehouses and other buildings
The old dockland area has been redeveloped into apartments.

the tendency to seek distraction and relief from unpleasant realities
Reading fantasy novels is a form of escapism for many people.

a weapon that projects a stream of burning fuel
The soldiers used a flamethrower to clear the dense undergrowth.

an expert in the study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these
A geographer studies maps and landforms.

the act of praising or honoring
The movie was criticized for its glorification of violence.

a person who causes emotional pain, or a disappointing event
Losing the game in the last minute was a real heartbreaker.

a style of popular music of US black and Hispanic origin, featuring rap and electronic backing
She enjoys listening to classic hiphop from the 90s.

a person who pursues a hobby
He started as a casual hobbyist but now builds complex model airplanes.

a short dash used to join words or parts of words
Remember to use a hyphen when writing "well-known."

a style of art or music that seeks to capture a fleeting impression of a subject
Monet is one of the most famous painters of Impressionism.

behavior or language that is considered morally offensive
The broadcast was fined for indecency by the regulatory body.

the space left at the beginning of a line of text
Please ensure consistent indentation throughout your code.

a large monitor lizard native to Indonesia
The Komodo dragon is the largest living species of lizard.

a venomous African snake
The black mamba is one of the most feared snakes in Africa.

a trial rendered invalid through an error in the proceedings
The judge declared a mistrial due to a hung jury.

a lightweight cotton fabric
She used a piece of muslin to strain the homemade cheese.

the back of the neck
She tied her hair up, revealing the nape of her neck.

something that puffs up
She wore a warm puffer jacket in the cold weather.

doctor specializing in medical imaging
The radiologist examined the X-ray to check for fractures.

athlete delaying participation
The coach decided to redshirt the promising freshman for a year.

new growth
After the fire, there was significant regrowth of vegetation.

a substance that slows down a chemical reaction or process
The curtains were treated with a fire retardant.

a person who makes rounds; a type of punch
The boxer delivered a powerful rounder to his opponent.

the state of being protected and cared for
He left his valuables with the bank for safekeeping.

a small line or stroke regularly attached to the end of a larger stroke in a letter or symbol
Times New Roman is a font with serifs.

the person responsible for the day-to-day operation of a television series
The showrunner announced the renewal of the series for another season.

fresh water, not salty
The explorers were searching for a source of sweetwater.

a type of freshwater fish
We had grilled tilapia for dinner last night.

a framework consisting of a horizontal bar supported by two pairs of sloping legs
They set up a temporary table using a wooden trestle.

a small, mouse-like rodent
A tiny vole scurried across the garden path.

Military aircraft
The warplane flew low over the enemy territory.

Area of conflict
Journalists often risk their lives reporting from a warzone.

Untamed forest
They ventured deep into the wildwood, far from any path.

Person addicted to work
My boss is a workaholic; he never takes a day off.
